notes: Frame the deck as a recovery agenda, not a post-mortem: H1 gaps are known and concentrated in commercial execution. Stress that leadership’s job is to back a focused reset with weekly oversight and fast decisions. Expect the question: which levers close the gap fastest in H2, and who owns each one?
title: H1 left the subscription business behind plan on bookings and renewals, so H2 requires a focused commercial reset
subtitle: This review shows that the shortfall sits in a few controllable revenue levers and that tighter renewal management, sharper pipeline conversion, and weekly operating discipline can restore momentum in the second half
